$comment: The beacons of NCode.Randomness, drawn by BeaconMatrix.astro on /reference/beacons/, one card per beacon, in this order. `name` is the name the beacon registers under. Booleans: hashChained, precommitment and fullyInProcess. Text fields take `code` and [links](/x/).

beacons.name: curby
beacons.title: CURBy-RNG
beacons.publishes: A pulse every minute, from CURBy, the University of Colorado Boulder's beacon, through the Twine API at `https://api.entwine.me/`
beacons.anchor: The chain's content identifier, `CurbyDefaults.RngChainId`, which fixes its RSA key
beacons.checks: Each document hashes to its content identifier and holds only Twine's members; each signature is canonical RS256 by the chain's key; the predecessor is one round earlier, and the salt matches its precommitment; every document's text is well-formed Unicode before any member is read
beacons.verifier: `CurbyPulseVerifier`: the chain, the pulse and its predecessor

beacons.name: curby-q
beacons.title: CURBy-Q
beacons.publishes: A round about every 13 minutes while it runs; none since 2025-08-22 (as of 2026-11-25), through the same Twine API
beacons.randomness: 64 bytes: the round's Trevisan extractor output
beacons.checks: Every pulse of the round is signed by the chain's key and follows the one before; a Bell pulse answers the request with the precommitted data hash; the seed expands by SHAKE256 from the right seed pulse to the committed parameters. The Bell-test certificate and the extraction are left to CURBy's `curby_verify`; every document's text is well-formed Unicode before any member is read
beacons.verifier: `CurbyQuantumRoundVerifier`: the round, its parameters and the documents it links to

beacons.name: nist
beacons.title: NIST Randomness Beacon 2.0
beacons.publishes: A pulse every minute, from chain 2 at `https://beacon.nist.gov/beacon/2.0/`
beacons.anchor: The certificate identifiers in `NistDefaults.CertificateIds`, each the SHA-512 hash of a certificate's DER encoding
beacons.checks: The certificate covers the pulse's timestamp; the RSA signature verifies over the signed fields; the output is the hash of those fields and the signature; the pulse chains to its predecessor's output and matches its precommitment; every document's text is well-formed Unicode before any member is read
beacons.verifier: `NistPulseVerifier`: the pulse, its predecessor and its certificate, and the predecessor's certificate across a rotation
beacons.pulseId: The pulse's output, in uppercase hex

beacons.name: drand
beacons.title: drand quicknet
beacons.publishes: A round every 3 seconds, from the League of Entropy, through `https://api.drand.sh/`
beacons.randomness: 32 bytes: the SHA-256 of the round's signature
beacons.checks: The BLS signature of the round number, hashed to the curve as RFC 9380 specifies, verifies against the pinned key; every document's text is well-formed Unicode before any member is read
beacons.pulseId: The round's signature, in lowercase hex
